slides.headline: The designer
slides.body: Gérald Genta was born in Geneva in 1931 and died in 2011.

slides.headline: The Royal Oak
slides.body: Inspired by vintage diving helmets, with exposed screws.

slides.headline: The Nautilus
slides.body: Patek Philippe introduced the Nautilus in 1976, designed by Genta.

slides.headline: The same hand
slides.body: Genta also designed IWC's Ingenieur, manufactured from 1976.
slides.visual_job: Template D body, kicker THE SAME HAND, text only

slides.headline: The Pasha
slides.body: Around 1985, Cartier asked Genta to redesign the Pasha.

slides.headline: Two steel icons. One designer.
